Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.anomaly_count
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics anomaly count by severity.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.app_crash_count
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics app crash count by client executable. Bounded by the central cardinality limiter: past cardinality.per_metric_limit the top executables by crash count are kept and the tail folds into app_name="other".

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.app_health.active_device_count
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics count of devices actively reporting application health, by OS version.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.app_health.device_count
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics device count, by application health state.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.app_health.mean_time_to_failure_minutes
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics application mean time to failure (minutes) per OS version; the int32-max 'no failures' sentinel is excluded.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.app_health.os_version_score
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics application health score (0-100) per OS version, by app-health state.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.baseline_score
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics baseline overall score, by baseline.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.battery_health.device_count
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics device count, by battery health state.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.battery_health_score
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics device battery health score (0-100), by health state; the -1 'not enough data' sentinel is excluded.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.boot_time_ms
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics device boot time, by restart category; the -1 'not enough data' sentinel is excluded.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.device_count
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics device count, by overall Endpoint Analytics health state.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.device_score
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics per-device score distribution (0-100), by score category.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.login_time_ms
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics device login time, by restart category; the -1 'not enough data' sentinel is excluded.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.model_device_count
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics scored-device count per device model. Microsoft publishes buckets as small as one device, so this is the real bucket size, not a floor.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.model_score
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics score (0-100) per device model, by score category. Bounded by the number of distinct (model, manufacturer) pairs in the fleet; the -1 'not enough data' sentinel is excluded rather than emitted as a negative score.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.resource_performance.device_count
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics device count, by resource performance health state.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.resource_performance_score
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics device resource performance score (0-100), by health state; the -1 'not enough data' sentinel is excluded.

Metrics.Name: intune.uxa.work_from_anywhere.device_count
Metrics.Description: Intune Endpoint Analytics device count by Windows 11 upgrade eligibility and health state; per-device readiness detail on the intune.device_work_from_anywhere log twin.
